messages:
mira: heads up — after today's canary (runtime v2.4.1 -> v2.5.0) we see p95 jump on text-gen endpoints. Noticed around 2026-03-17T15:34Z. customer escalations coming. anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: canary rollout started 2026-03-17T15:30Z, 5% traffic -> v2.5.0 on hostpool canary-usw2.

kevin: grabbing metrics. mira, paste p95/p99 and an example req id?

mira: p95: 220ms -> 780ms, p99: ~2.1s. sample req req_0a1b2c. spike correlates with canary hosts (canary-usw2-b).

jen: tail from runtime logs on canary node:
```
[15:33:45] runtime: batch_window_ms=20
[15:33:46] router: late-binding route used for tenant acme-inc
[15:33:46] kvcache: miss_rate=0.78
[15:33:46] io: nvme_qdepth=128 io_lat_ms=45
```

sarah: flamegraph shows worker threads stuck in NVMe read for model quant files, strange — we switched to quantized 4-bit artifacts in this rollout.

kevin: hypothesis: quantized model changed memory access pattern causing NVMe pressure on cold cache + batch_window increased -> larger batches -> IO storms. check runtime.conf in canary:
```
batch_window_ms: 20
kv_warmup: false
kernel_scheduler: fair-share
``` 

mira: canary only 10% but late-binding routes high-QPS tenants to canary hosts -> disproportionate impact. Proposal: 1) temporary rollback canary hosts to v2.4.1 2) traffic-split high-QPS tenants away 3) enable kv_warmup and lower batch_window_ms to 8 before rerolling

jen: ready to rollback. kubectl patch deploy runtime-canary -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","image":"redwood/runtime:v2.4.1"}]}}}}'

kevin: I'll open a bisect job to toggle only kernel_scheduler and batch_window to see which change causes p95 jump. creating job now.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0043 created, sev=2, affected_customers=[acme-inc, betaworks]

sarah: running bisect: job id bisect-50321, will test combos: (kernel_scheduler: fair-share|latency-priority) x (batch_window_ms:8|20) x (kv_warmup:true|false)

mira: thanks. I'll update support and post a status page note. ping me when rollback completes :eyes:

jen: rollback started, will post when pods are 100% on v2.4.1

kevin: added temporary routing rule to shift acme-inc to dedicated-pool: redwoodctl traffic split --tenant acme-inc --to dedicated-pool --percent 100

sarah: early results: after rollback p95 back to ~230ms on affected tenants, p99 down to ~450ms. leaving bisect running to get root cause.

mira: great work — keep thread updated, label followup for infra perf (postmortem + perf test to reproduce quant+io)

kevin: note for postmortem: add reproducible load test with quantized artifact on NVMe-limited node type, and include KV cache warmup scenarios.

mira: closing escalation after support notif. thanks all :heart:
